titles.romaji: Megumi to Taiyou: Kajuu Gummi Tweet Love Story
titles.native: メグミとタイヨウ 果汁グミ Tweet Love Story

description:
The "Megumi and Taiyou" commercial depicts the reunion of a girl named Megumi, who was raised near a grape orchard, and her childhood friend Taiyou.

(Source: Anime News Network)
